title: Fall of the (Western) Roman Empire
description: Added from the Generations curriculum import (Taking Europe for Jesus). Dated only by the Generations books cited below; no tier 1–4 chronology covers this event.

chronologies.note: From the book's "Ancient Empires" pages (credited in an image to Daily Bible Study, keyway.ca). The span of the ancient Roman empire; the year here is its end, 476. (Its start, about 145 B.C., differs by a year from PDF p. 40, where Rome begins to take over Greece in 146 B.C.)
